rule: Start the continuation at the first eligible observation during the verified right support window. End it when support, gyro sign or envelope eligibility is first lost. Require a recognized left support before starting it again.
paired_start: Restore the same physics, actuator delay and model history, onset observer memory, and continuation latches before each arm.
stage_order: Compare the two low-friction development seeds first. Nominal comparisons are required before admission as a replacement over the full range.
